h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mehsana

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mehsana

items.pText: Mehsana in north Gujarat is a dairy and oilfield district with hot, dry summers and bright sun for most of the year. Schools, housing societies and company colonies here often ask us about colour: which shades stay attractive in strong sunlight, and which suit a school uniform or a society's look. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at Vasai, Maharashtra, about 470 km from Mehsana, and delivers it by road.

Colour is one of the easier decisions once the layout is done. Send us the site size, the age group and photos, and we will suggest equipment and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing. When you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture in your chosen shades and install through our team or a dealer in Gujarat.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Choosing colours for a sunny site

c: Our roto-moulded parts come in more than 15 colour shades. The colour is part of the plastic itself, so it does not chip off the way paint does. On a site in full sun, lighter tones stay cooler to touch than very dark ones, so use them for slide beds and deck panels that children sit on.
Many schools match the playground to their uniform or logo, and builders often pick a palette that suits the building's front. Two or three colours usually look better than a rainbow. Our
themed sets show how colour can carry a theme. See also our

items.q: How many colours can we choose from?
items.a: Our roto-moulded parts come in more than 15 shades. We can match a school's or society's colours where the range allows, and design customisation is available on request.

items.q: Will the colours fade in Mehsana's sun?
items.a: The colour runs through the roto-moulded plastic rather than sitting on the surface as paint, so it does not chip. Lighter shades also stay cooler in direct sun.

items.q: Do you deliver to Mehsana and north Gujarat?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in Gujarat.
